meta_title: Davison K & Son | Emergency Plumber Middlesbrough
meta_description: Davison K & Son are your trusted emergency plumber in Middlesbrough. Fast response, honest pricing, and reliable service. Call now for same-day repairs.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or boiler breakdown in Middlesbrough? We're out within the hour, any time of day or night.
services_subhead: From emergency callouts to full installations, we handle every plumbing job with speed and skill.

services.title: Emergency Callouts
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast. We carry parts on the van and aim to have you back to normal within hours, not days.

services.title: Boiler Repair & Installation
services.desc: Expert diagnosis and repair of faulty boilers, plus new system installations with 10-year warranty. Keep your heating reliable and your bills low.

services.title: Leak Detection & Repair
services.desc: Hidden leaks waste money and damage your home. We locate the source quickly and repair it properly, stopping the damage before it spreads.

services.title: Central Heating Maintenance
services.desc: Annual servicing keeps your system running efficiently and catches problems early. Regular care extends system life and reduces repair costs.

services.title: Radiator & Pipework Installation
services.desc: New radiators, towel rails, and updated pipework fitted to your home's layout. We modernise outdated systems and improve heat distribution.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: Full installation of bathrooms and kitchens, including water supply, drainage, and fixture fitting. We handle all pipework to code.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I hate seeing homeowners ripped off by cowboys.
about_para_1: Davison K & Son has been serving Middlesbrough and the surrounding area for nearly two decades. What began as a one-man operation has grown into a respected local team — but we've never lost our core values. Every job, whether an emergency callout or a full bathroom install, is treated with the same care and attention.
about_para_2: Our customers trust us because we turn up on time, we explain what's wrong in plain English, and we charge a fair price. We don't sell jobs you don't need. Repeat business and word-of-mouth referrals are the backbone of our success, and that's exactly how we like it.
reviews_heading: What Middlesbrough Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe on a Saturday morning — total nightmare. Called Davison K & Son and they were here in under 50 minutes. Fixed it properly, even repaired the kitchen wall damage without fussing. Fair price, professional job. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: New boiler installation. From the quote to the finished job, everything was smooth and on schedule. The lads were tidy, explained everything, and left no mess. Heating works a treat now and bills have dropped noticeably. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Linda P.

reviews.text: Emergency call at 11pm with a radiator leak. They came out, diagnosed it, and had it sorted by midnight. Didn't try to upsell me on unnecessary stuff. Genuinely honest tradesmen. Will use them again and have already recommended to mates.
reviews.author: David H.
